text: Hi, I'm Karishma. Last week, I completed and validated Madison's first persona-aware prompt data set. This week, I built the offline pilot workflow that prepares those prompts for future model testing. The data set has 39 unique laptop recommendation prompts. For the initial pilot, I proposed three repetitions per prompt, creating 117 planned runs. Repetitions test run-to-run consistency. They are separate from the three wording variants already in the data set. The tool creates a reproducibly shuffled schedule. Each repetition block contains every prompt once, and each run keeps its prompt ID, exact wording, data set version, repetition number, and unique run ID. I also built an API runner with

An optional OpenAI adapter. Once access is approved and configured, it will send every question as a fresh, independent request, and save the full answer with its question ID, model details, timestamp, and attempt number. This removes the need to enter every question and copy every answer manually. In offline mode, it prepares the requests without sending anything. The workflow creates empty response slots marked not run, plus a template for future attempts. It records model settings, timestamps, raw responses, usage, errors, and execution status. A planned slot is never counted as an observation. The data set validation still passes. All five offline runner tests pass, and the preview prepares all

117 requests while sending zero. The collection validator also rejects empty placeholders as experimental data. I drafted rules for distinguishing brand mentions from actual recommendations, preserving evidence, recording presentation order without assuming rank, and reporting the denominator behind every visibility rate. This is pilot infrastructure, not a completed experiment. I have made zero live model queries, collected zero answers, calculated no visibility metrics, and reached no findings about persona effects. Next, I need to confirm the model and configure approved API access. I'll begin with a few real requests to verify the connection and answer according workflow before starting the full pilot.
